title: Twenty balanced questions
hook: Two stated cases: explore the maximum number of distinct answer strings.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the maximum number of distinct answer strings affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Capacity, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the maximum number of distinct answer strings in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: Balanced questions can use the available answer sequences efficiently. Counting sequences is a capacity bound, not a guarantee that a particular puzzle achieves it. This comparison isolates the maximum number of distinct answer strings.
